feeds.title: Decorilla
feeds.description: Decorilla is a new way to get the designer rooms you've always wanted… but never thought you could afford. By combining traditional in-home interior design and technology, they have created a platform connecting customers with professional vetted designers, streamlining the design process, and making beautiful interior design affordable and risk free.

feeds.title: J.P. Hoffman Blog
feeds.description: J.P. Hoffman Design Build. is a Full-Service Design, Build, Remodeling, and General Contractor serving areas South of Boston. A family-owned and run company, Husband and Wife Team, Jason and Megan Hoffman implement the company's core values in everything they do. On the blog, they share project updates, restoration photos, and other news related to the Design Build and General Contracting communities.

feeds.title: Boston Modern Staging & Design Blog
feeds.description: Boston Modern Staging & Design is a company that specializes in both home staging and interior design throughout the city of Boston and surrounding areas. Visit the blog for the latest on home staging, interior design, home decor, and more. Easy DIY home projects and fabulous home item finds!

feeds.title: PFNY Designs Blog
feeds.description: PFNY Designs is a full-service interior design firm. We believe in generating spaces that are both livable and extraordinary. From Cape Cod to Newport, to Fairfield County and NYC, they work with clients to realize their lifestyle goals by creating beautiful, livable spaces that also answer functional and financial considerations.

feeds.title: Linda Merrill Blog
feeds.description: Linda Merrill is an award-winning interior designer based in Massachusetts. Linda's blog, Surroundings, has an international readership and is often named to Best Blog and Design Influencer lists and was most recently named to the Top 19 Interior Designers in Boston by Expertise. Follow this blog to know more about interior design in New England.

feeds.title: Bee's Knees Interior Design Blog
feeds.description: Through the Beehive Blog, we detail aspects of our style, challenges, and triumphs of our projects, personal stories from the Bees, and more. Read more to see the behind-the-scenes of our classic New England style and our detailed processes. Bee's Knees Interior Design is a full-service design firm serving clients in the Greater Boston area.

feeds.title: Dane Austin Design Journal
feeds.description: Featuring the Writings and reflections of Dane Austin Design. This Journal provides a point of view into our process and Interior Design Mystique that we incorporate into our smooth services. Dane Austin Design is a full-service interior design firm based in Boston, specializing in luxury residential interiors across the nation.

feeds.title: Joanne Modica Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Bella Casa is a blog by Joanne Modica. On this blog, she shares stories, inspirations, and design ideas that share the single goal of making your life and your home a little more beautiful. Joanne and her Interior Design team are dedicated to making your home feel connected, creative, and exciting. We focus on homes in Boston and Surrounding areas.

feeds.title: Shelter Interior Design Blog
feeds.description: Shelter blog shares home, fashion, and lifestyle greatness. Get spurred to design your homes with our Makeover ideas, Style edits, Kitchen exhibits, and many more categories. Shelter by Julie Richard is a boutique design firm specializing in residential interior design projects.

feeds.title: Gray Oak Studio Blog
feeds.description: The Gray Oak Studio blog is where we share client projects, personal projects, design tips, and the occasional rant about our favorite reality shows. Diving into an Aesthetic that can be described at Modern Casual, Gray Oak Studio delivers and designs functional spaces that you love to call home. throughout the Boston area and the North Shore.

feeds.title: Palm & Prep Blog
feeds.description: Explore Decor guides, Makeover stories, and Interior Decor Musings by Jennifer Minns. Palm & Prep Design is a full-service boutique residential interior design firm serving Boston's South Shore and beyond. Palm & Prep proudly works with a limited number of design clients annually to offer unparalleled customer service, beautifying home interiors primarily in Boston.

feeds.title: New England Home Magazine » Interior Designers
feeds.description: New England Home is dedicated to showcasing the unique architecture, design, and building that defines the luxury home in New England. From urban lofts to mountain retreats, from oceanfront compounds to suburban estates, New England Home celebrates the very best of living in New England. Additionally, the magazine shared insightful articles on how to brighten up your living space with new ideas, along with interviews and whats in tren in their Interior Designers section.

feeds.title: Glitter » Home Décor Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2010, Glitter, Inc. is a lifestyle and entertaining site filled to the brim with fashion and beauty, home décor and DIYs, recipes, family adventures, and plenty of parties along the way. Find all the home decor archives here for the North Carolina blog Glitter, Inc. Founder Lexi shares her love for home decor and features fantastic pieces.

feeds.title: Carolyn Thayer's Interior Design Blog
feeds.description: Carolyn Thayer Interiors Interior design blog offers tips and suggestions for easy ways to decorate and furnish your home or apartment. Carolyn Thayer Interiors is an interior design firm with an office in Boston. We combine practical classics with modern functions while striving to create a style of endurance and beauty.

feeds.title: Elements of Style Blog » Interiors
feeds.description: Covers everything fundamental and peripheral about Interiors - From Furniture, Accessories, the Latest trends, and Advice for Kids & Families to Cheeky design tips. Elements of Style is a Design Blog by Erin Gates Design, a design firm and brand with multiple product lines and collaborations.
